title: Evaluating diversion and treatment policies for opioid use disorder
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating public health policies and their societal and economic impacts using a simulation model. While the outcomes (e.g., reducing deaths, improving quality of life) have ethical dimensions, the paper does not engage in the evaluation or benchmarking of ethical frameworks, religious aspects, or moral philosophies as a core component of its methodology.
